messages.subject: Invitation: lunchtime CPD - W&I insurance in mid-market M&A
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello all,

A reminder that the corporate team's lunchtime CPD on warranty and indemnity insurance is on Thursday 5 February, 12:30-13:30 in the Bishopsgate training room (sandwiches provided). 1 hour CPD. Please RSVP if attending.

Donna Bridges | Practice Assistant
